visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with fair skin and dark hair wears a white plush bunny-ear headband and a navy blue sweatshirt with white lettering. She stands indoors against a plain cream wall, gesturing with both hands pointed upward while speaking excitedly. (2) A close-up view shows a white, curved adhesive patch held by hands; the patch is covered in tiny black specks resembling freckles. (3) The woman applies the white patch across the bridge of her nose and upper cheeks, pressing it down with her fingers to ensure it adheres to her skin. (4) The scene shifts to a different aesthetic; the woman now has long, silvery-blue hair and wears a black zip-up hoodie with white graphic patterns and a black cap. Her face is adorned with shimmering, glittery freckles in the area where the patch was applied. She poses and smiles in bright, natural daylight. (5) The woman is seen outdoors in a full outfit, including the black hoodie and matching sweatpants with white graphics, posing near a row of black mailboxes and green bushes under a clear blue sky. (6) Back in an indoor setting, the woman uses a white wet wipe to vigorously rub her cheek, looking into a mirror with a surprised and slightly distressed expression as the glitter freckles remain largely intact despite her efforts to remove them.
